item.text: I’ll record one evidence-based decision for each supplied profile, using only the provided information, then check the submission status.

item.command: /bin/zsh -lc './submit_profile "KM Vermeulen" accept "The initials match exactly and the Groningen clinical record coherently includes health-related quality-of-life measurement and cost-effectiveness studies. Its patient-outcomes focus is consistent with the supplied Descriptive Systems project on selecting health attributes."'

/bin/zsh -lc "./submit_profile \"Knut Stavem\" accept \"Exact name, Norwegian institutional context, and extensive quality-of-life/EQ-5D record are consistent. The profile contains the supplied project title, \\\"Validity of EQ-5D-5L breathing and cognition bolt-ons in non-hospitalized patients after COVID-19\\\", directly confirming the identity.\""

/bin/zsh -lc './submit_profile "Koonal Shah" accept "Exact name and NICE affiliation match. The extensive EuroQol valuation portfolio directly covers EQ-5D-5L value sets, EuroQol TTO protocols, EQ-5D-Y valuation, child/adolescent health states, and the conceptual valuation themes of the supplied projects."'

The record includes quality-of-life valuation work (AQoL-8D and adolescent AQoL-6D) alongside India-focused poverty, food, and inequality research, consistent with the India EQ-5D project."'
